Dig up 5 facts from last lesson

  1. What deal did X-Ray make with Stanley? Stanley must give him anything he finds
  2. Why is X-Ray called X-Ray? it's Pig Latin for Rex
  3. What did Mr Pendanski say to Zero in the circle? "You're not completely worthless."
  4. What was on the end of the gold tube? a heart with the letters K B
  5. Why did Stanley give the tube to X-Ray? he promised, and he wants X-Ray to accept him

WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet A: chapter 14
A1How does X-Ray "find" the gold tube?
X-Ray pretends to ...
X-Ray pretends to find it in his own hole the next morning, just after the water truck comes.
A2What is the big surprise about the Warden?
The surprise is that the Warden is ...
The surprise is that the Warden is a woman. Stanley didn't know until she stepped out of the truck.
A3Give 2 details about how the Warden looks.
The Warden is ___ with ___. She wears ___ .
Look for: hair, hat, boots, skin, fingernails.
The Warden is tall with red hair and freckles. She wears a black cowboy hat and black boots with turquoise stones.
A4What does the Warden keep saying to Mr Pendanski? What does it show?
She keeps saying "___". This shows that she ...
She keeps saying "Excuse me." This shows that she is in control and won't let anyone question her authority.
A5Why does the Warden make Mr Pendanski fill the canteens again, even though he just filled them?
She makes him fill them because ... She also wants to show that ...
She makes him fill them because the boys have been drinking in the heat. She also wants to show that he must do what she says "without questioning my authority".
Extension (early finishers): the Warden speaks in a soft voice. Why is that scarier than shouting?

Pause at: "We don't want to miss anything" · "hidden microphones" · "looking in the wrong place"
WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet B: chapter 15
B1How does the Warden change the way the boys dig?
The boys work in ___. One boy ___ and the other ___ .
The boys work in pairs. One boy digs and the other carefully checks the dirt as he shovels it into a wheelbarrow.
B2"The main thing is not to miss anything." What does this show about the Warden?
This shows that the Warden is looking for ...
This shows that the Warden is looking for something special, and she really wants to find it.
B3Why did X-Ray snap at Stanley at breakfast?
X-Ray snapped at him because he was afraid that ...
What do Zigzag and Armpit say is hidden all over the camp?
X-Ray snapped at him because he was afraid that the Warden was listening through hidden microphones.
B4What does Stanley realise at the end of the chapter?
He realises they are not digging to ___. They are ___, but in the ___ .
He realises they are not digging to "build character". They are looking for something, but in the wrong place.
B5Stretch: Stanley "dug the hole into his memory". What does this mean? Why might it matter later?
It means he ... It might matter later because ...
It means he remembers exactly where he really found the tube. It might matter later because that is where the Warden should be digging.
B4 is the big idea of today: the digging has a secret purpose.
SAY ITTHEN WRITEDetective board

STEP 1: SAY IT Read the clues. What do they tell us?

Ch 4"If you dig up anything interesting, you are to report it."
Ch 10"The Warden isn't interested in fossils."
Ch 14About the gold tube: "I think the Warden is going to like this."
Ch 15"We're going to dig the dirt twice... We don't want to miss anything."
Ch 15"I've waited this long, I can wait another day."
Ch 3 + 13K B... and a famous outlaw who robbed people.

STEP 2: WRITE your theory with 2 clues

I think the Warden is looking for ___ because in chapter ___ ... Also, in chapter ___ ...
I think the Warden is looking for treasure because in chapter 15 she makes the boys dig the dirt twice so they don't miss anything. Also, in chapter 14 she is excited about the gold tube with K B on it.
Any theory is fine if it is backed up with 2 clues from the book.
SAY ITTHEN WRITECharacter File: the Warden

STEP 1: SAY IT What does each one show?

Mr Pendanski has to do what she says.POWERFUL
She owns the shade and the hammock (ch 1).POWERFUL
She knows every boy's name before meeting them.WATCHFUL
"We don't want to miss anything."DETERMINED
"Excuse me," in a soft voice.SIGNATURE
Her fingernails are painted dark red.SIGNATURE

Choose from: powerful · watchful · determined · signature

STEP 2: WRITE at the back of your notebook

The Warden

Detail 1: She is ___: she ___ (ch __)

Detail 2: She is ___: she ___ (ch __)

Signature: ___

Detail 1: She is powerful: even Mr Pendanski must obey her when she says "Excuse me" (ch 14).
Detail 2: She is determined: she makes the boys dig the dirt twice so they "don't miss anything" (ch 15).
Signature: she says "Excuse me" in a soft voice.
Try to choose different evidence from the model. We will add more about the Warden soon!
